about: Typed answers to practice questions (each at seed 7), marked as a teacher would: correct; close (a rounding slip); wrong; form (the right idea, sent back: not simplified, not factorised, not exact, a root missing, unreadable). A wrong answer may also name the mistake a teacher would see in it (mistake). Used by scripts/checker-agreement.ts and tests/checker.test.ts to measure how often the answer checker agrees.
